textEncoding: strict ASCII, no controls; invalid fields length=-1 and cleared bytes; never truncate
publication: Writer marks offset24 odd, full barrier, writes mutable regions while retaining immutable bytes, full barrier, marks offset24 even. Creation and Dispose write the full record except offset24; every accepted even publication is a complete 1024-byte snapshot. Consumer reads seq, barrier, copies 1024 bytes, barrier, rereads seq; must same nonzero even, retry max3 without sleep.
readScope: readPending includes awaiting read/continuation and does not prove a sent request exists; commandDecoded is parsed metadata only, not accepted tuple; submitFrameHandler includes encoding, backend and synchronous cost work. Extension separates switch and due cost windows; returns are unwind boundaries, not success or consumer/ACK proof.
failure: Errors disable only diagnostic evidence, never throw into input handlers. CreateNew only; do not adopt an existing named mapping. Caller requests MSI evidence only from authoritative MSI engineering Native launch; ordinary six-argument launches remain unchanged.
tests: Synthetic byte sinks/decoder and extracted parser only; no product/Host/probe/real services/device operations

extension.beginRead: Clear all four per-request stamps; retain extensionVersion.
extension.compatibility: Missing marker (old v1), unsupported version or invalid stamp relationships expose no backend/cost evidence. New phases require valid extension. Zero individual stamps are unknown.
extension.backendScope: Actual persona switch including report construction and SDK dispatch; finally publishes return even on throw, never consumer proof.
extension.costScope: Host due-window interval: legacy synchronous diagnostic work or MSI bounded immutable handoff plus producer reset. Deferred background worker time is excluded. HELLO advertises MSI requested and available capability. Cost return is not ACK.
